title: Order exported in COMMA_SEPARATED format with a description containing commas
rationale: Exercises the Athena/CSV configuration axis on realistic data. The delimiter collision is explicitly documented in the MapFlattener class javadoc with a recommendation to use JSON instead, so the ambiguity is a design decision - but this also exposes what the reconstructor does with the ambiguity, which that documentation does not cover.
catchesBugClass: Format-specific value/delimiter collision. Also proves the reconstructor arrayFormat setting is actually consulted.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch anything about PIPE_SEPARATED or BRACKET_LIST, which take different branches in both serializeArray and parseArrayValue. It also cannot distinguish "ambiguous input" from "reconstructor fabricates rows".

predicted.detail: Defensible because the format exists to feed CSV/Athena SERDEs that cannot represent an embedded delimiter, the collision is documented verbatim, and a lossless alternative is one builder call away. NOT defensible, and worth separate triage: the reconstructor fabricates extra rows and duplicates values rather than reporting that the element counts disagree.
